notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124), no block encountered on any of 137 requests (homepage https://www.ikea.com/jp/ja/ + 136 leaf category pages, all HTTP 200); Playwright/CDP and Claude-in-Chrome were not needed. robots.txt (https://www.ikea.com/robots.txt; the jp/ja path itself defers to the global file) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry and no blanket 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' - only specific search/filter/sort/compare query-param paths are disallowed, none of which were used. TREE: Built from the site's own 'catalogSlim' JSON array embedded inline in the homepage HTML (https://www.ikea.com/jp/ja/) - this mirrors the exact IKEA.jp mega-menu, with nested 'subs' arrays down to leaf category pages. This is the same mechanism used for the sibling IKEA storefronts in this project (SR92 UK, SR107 DE, SR164 UAE); the JP catalogSlim tree is structurally near-identical to all three (same category IDs/slugs throughout, e.g. tl001 Textiles, tl002 Curtains & blinds, st001 Storage & organisation, st007 Small storage & organisers - one node, 14317, is locally named 'OMAR' in JP vs 'OLAUS' in the UAE tree, same ID/position), confirming this is the same global IKEA taxonomy localised for JP, not independently re-derived, though every leaf's own quantity/h1/canonical was independently fetched and verified against the live JP site, not copied from a sibling locale. Roots crawled: Textiles (tl001), Curtains & blinds (tl002), Storage & organisation (st001), Small storage & organisers (st007), plus the storage/textile-relevant subset of Bathroom furniture & storage (ba001), Laundry & cleaning (lc001), Kitchenware & tableware (kt001), and Baby & children (bc001) for items that only nest under those roots. bc001 was fully walked and every storage/textile leaf under it turned out to be an identical node ID already reached from st001/st007/tl001 (e.g. Children's storage & organisation 18706, Baby textiles 18690, Children's textiles 18730) - no unique new leaves there except two (18775 Children's bed accessories & canopies under 18730, and 18695 Baby blankets & quilts under 18690) which are recorded once, under their own group. QTY: extracted directly from each category page's rendered result-count text (pattern '<N>件中<M>件表示', i.e. 'N total, showing M') via regex - the exact total IKEA.jp displays above the product grid (storage.md Sec.36 rule 2 / textile.md Sec.28 pattern), not paginated or estimated. Fetched via 10-way concurrent HTTP requests over the 136 curated leaf node IDs; every single one returned a valid count with HTTP 200, no manual-review fallbacks needed for quantity itself. Every leaf's rendered <h1> and <link rel=canonical> were captured and cross-checked against the requested node - all 136 matched exactly (0 mismatches, verified programmatically), confirming no leaf silently served a parent/sibling/site-wide total. All 136 leaf links across both arrays are unique (0 duplicates, verified programmatically). EFFICIENCY ROLLUPS (matching UK/DE/UAE precedent for this very deep IKEA catalog): all 14 named modular storage systems present on IKEA.jp (PAX, BESTA, PLATSA, EKET, SMASTAD, IVAR, BROR, BOAXEL, JONAXEL, JOSTEIN, TROFAST, ELVARLI, OMAR, LADMAKARE) recorded at the system level (one row per system) rather than exploding into every combination/frame/door/part sub-page, since all sub-pages describe the same underlying storage-furniture product differing only by module/finish; Wardrobes (19053) similarly kept as one leaf rather than its 12 door/installation-style sub-pages and its lighting accessory sub-tree (16283). EXCLUDED (checked, not included): Curtain rods & rails and all curtain hardware (18891/18892/18893/18894/700426 - hardware, not fabric), Sewing accessories (14350, notions/tools not a fabric product, appears under both tl001 and tl002), Window films & accessories (700628, adhesive film not textile), Venetian blinds (700599, aluminium slat blinds - not fabric/textile), Anti-slip rug underlays (10699, rubber/PVC grip accessory not a rug/textile itself), Clothing & accessories (42925, apparel), Brackets (20659, mounting hardware), Bedside/side tables (20656) and Dressing tables (20657, surface furniture, not storage), Sideboards & console tables hub (30454, duplicates the narrower Sideboards & buffets 10412 plus non-storage Console tables 16246), Kitchen islands & trolleys (10471, kitchen serving furniture, excluded from the Trolleys node while Bathroom trolleys 20858 kept), Room dividers/partitions (46080) and Hallway furniture sets (700411, mixed furniture sets), Noticeboards (10574) and Hangers (20618) and bare Hooks (20617, hardware not containers - Hooks & hangers subgroup 16274 excluded in full), Recycling bins / waste-paper & pedal bins / bathroom bins / recycling bags (34470/16215/48940/16214, waste disposal not organisational storage of belongings), personal-carry Bags (Shopping/tote 16295, Backpacks 27821, Travel accessories 16255, Cool bags 46082 - fashion/travel carrying items excluded per storage.md Sec.6, only Bag organisers 47441 kept), Moving supplies (46078, packing materials not home storage), most of Bathroom accessories (Bathroom bins 48940, Soap dispensers & dishes 10656, Toilet brushes 48944, Toothbrush holders 48943 - hygiene fixtures not storage; Shower caddies 10658 and No-drill bathroom accessories 700699 were kept as genuine storage racks/caddies), Bathroom stools & benches (20859, seating furniture), Drying racks (20602), Ironing boards (20608, appliance/tool not storage - explicit storage.md Sec.11 exclusion), Dishwashing accessories (15938) and Cleaning accessories (20609, cleaning tools not storage), Water bottles & travel mugs (700352, drinkware/travel not home storage), Garage storage hub (700440, an orphaned parent - every child was a duplicate of a system/node already recorded elsewhere under st001/st007), the entire Bathroom vanity-range collections (HAVBACK/ANGSJON/TANNFORSEN/ENHET/NYSJON/VIDVESSEL, each bundling a sink+mirror+tap+countertop+cabinet as one fixture system) and the standalone Bathroom vanities group (20719/20720/54989) and Mirror cabinets (20500) - excluded as bathroom fixtures per storage.md Sec.14/28, matching UK/DE/UAE precedent, except Under-sink cabinets (20721) which was kept and flagged LOW as a genuine standalone storage cabinet, Bathroom mirrors (20490 and its sub-nodes), Bathroom lighting (10736), Bathroom countertops (30565), Bathroom sinks (20723), Bathroom taps (20724), Showers (40690) and Shower hook/rail sets (40693, hardware). Duplicate cross-linked nodes (same category ID reachable from more than one menu path - e.g. Children's chests of drawers/wardrobes/rugs/towels/bedding reachable from both a top-level storage/textile group and the Children's/Baby storage-organisation/textiles hubs under bc001; Wall shelves reachable from both Bookcases & shelving units and Hooks & wall organisation; Laundry baskets reachable from both Small storage & organisers, Bathroom laundry ba003 and Laundry & cleaning lc001; Food storage & organising 15937 reachable from both Small storage & organisers and Kitchenware & tableware kt001; Table linen 20538 reachable from both Textiles and Kitchenware & tableware; BOAXEL system 47394 reachable from both Wall shelves and Storage solution systems) were each recorded exactly once under their single most specific/primary parent, never duplicated - zero duplicate links confirmed programmatically across both arrays. LOW-CONFIDENCE flags (8 total, review-queued per rule): Bathrobes & spa accessories (700339, mixed category, also contains non-textile spa items); Picture ledges (16305, art-display shelf, may be closer to Wall Decor than Storage); Under-sink cabinets (20721, genuine storage cabinet but sold as part of an otherwise-excluded bathroom vanity range); Towel rails, bathroom racks & hooks (20615, combined node, towel-rail/hook portion is hardware not a storage container); Cable management & accessories (16195, borderline storage/organisation utility, not itself a container); Children's hooks & wall organisers (20481, combined node, hooks are hardware while wall organiser is genuine storage); Desk accessories (10573, general desk-accessories category, likely includes non-storage items alongside organisers); Laundry accessories (55004, general laundry-accessories category, likely includes non-storage items alongside storage-purpose ones).
